templates.name: Customer Advisor
templates.description:
Customer Advisor - Customer Operations

We are looking for a dedicated Customer Advisor to join our Customer Operations team. The postholder will handle a wide range of customer enquiries, account queries, and service requests, ensuring every interaction is dealt with professionally, accurately, and within agreed timescales.

Key Responsibilities:
- Responding to customer enquiries via phone, email, and digital channels in a professional, friendly, and timely manner
- Resolving customer account queries, transaction questions, and product-related issues at first point of contact
- Guiding customers through onboarding processes, including the collection and verification of identification and supporting documentation in line with KYC requirements
- Recognising and escalating potential fraud or unusual customer behaviour to the relevant internal team in line with escalation procedures
- Logging and managing customer complaints in accordance with regulatory timeframes
- Updating customer records accurately and in accordance with GDPR and data protection policies
- Working collaboratively with internal teams such as Operations, Risk & Compliance, and Product Teams
- Meeting individual and team performance targets including quality, productivity, and customer satisfaction measures

Requirements:
- Previous experience in a customer-facing service role, ideally within financial services
- Strong verbal communication skills with the ability to explain complex information clearly
- Ability to remain calm and professional when handling difficult conversations
- Good written communication skills for email correspondence and complaint documentation
- Organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple queries simultaneously
- Basic working knowledge of Microsoft Office and CRM systems

templates.name: Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO)
templates.description:
Deputy Money Laundering Reporting Officer (DMLRO) - Risk and Compliance

The Deputy MLRO within the second line of defence (2LOD) supports the MLRO to provide an expert advisory and monitoring service to ensure compliance with relevant rules, regulations and codes of conduct relating to Fraud and Financial Crime (F&FC).

Key Responsibilities:
- Lead the design, development and ongoing review of the Bank's Fraud and Financial Crime Risk Management Policies covering AML/CTF, Sanctions, Tax Evasion, Market Abuse, Bribery & Corruption and Fraud
- Provide regular reports and management information to the MLRO, Chief Risk Officer and Board on the Bank's F&FC Risk profile
- Support delivery of the annual MLRO report to the relevant Board Committee
- Design and facilitate a group-wide F&FC risk assessment including control effectiveness
- Undertake investigations regarding potential cases of suspected fraud and financial crime
- Suspicious activity report investigation, discounting and submission of SARs to the relevant Reporting Authority
- Review suspected cases of fraud and investigate to determine if referral to law enforcement is necessary
- Provide oversight and challenge to business unit Risk and Control Self Assessments
- Design and delivery of F&FC Training content and provision
- Monitor and report on staff compliance with F&FC training requirements
- Quality assurance sampling of F&FC activity and control testing conducted in 1LOD
- Deliver thematic reviews of F&FC policies and controls
- Monitor, assess and report on emerging legislative and regulatory developments
- Deputise for the MLRO when required

Requirements:
- Detailed operational knowledge of UK regulatory and legal requirements regarding financial crime compliance
- Experience in translating legislation into clear business-focused procedures and guidance
- Ability to anticipate and evaluate potential fraud and financial crime risks at a strategic level
- Experience in presenting to Board, Board Committees and/or Senior Management
- Experience in a financial crime senior management position within financial services
- Skilled in building strong and productive relationships with internal and external stakeholders
- Hold a Fraud and/or Financial Crime qualification at a professional level (e.g. ICA Diploma or CAMS)

templates.name: Transaction Monitoring Analyst
templates.description:
Transaction Monitoring (TM) Analyst - Fraud & Financial Crime

We are seeking a Transaction Monitoring Analyst to support the Bank's anti-money laundering framework by reviewing and investigating transaction monitoring alerts generated through the Bank's automated systems.

Key Responsibilities:
- Reviewing transaction monitoring alerts on a daily basis, assessing each against customer risk profiles, account history, and expected transaction behaviour
- Conducting thorough and well-documented investigations into flagged activity, gathering supporting evidence and context
- Determining whether alerts should be discounted, monitored, or escalated as potential suspicious activity
- Preparing clear and accurate investigation notes and case records for audit and compliance purposes
- Escalating cases meeting the threshold for a Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) to the nominated officer
- Identifying typologies and emerging patterns in transaction activity that may indicate money laundering, fraud, or other financial crime
- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date case management records throughout the lifecycle of an investigation
- Supporting periodic reviews of higher-risk customer accounts by providing transaction analysis
- Adhering to SLA requirements for alert review and escalation
- Contributing to team quality assurance activities and continuous improvement

Requirements:
- Experience in a transaction monitoring or financial crime analytical role
- Understanding of AML/CTF legislation and regulatory obligations of UK financial institutions
- Ability to review and interpret financial transaction data to identify suspicious patterns
- Strong attention to detail with the ability to make well-reasoned, risk-based decisions
- Good written communication skills with experience producing clear investigation notes
- Proficient in Microsoft Excel and case management systems
- Experience using automated transaction monitoring platforms (e.g. NICE Actimize, Temenos) is desirable

templates.name: KYC Analyst
templates.description:
KYC (Know Your Customer) Analyst - Compliance Team

The KYC Analyst acts as the first line of defense against financial crime. They verify client identities and assess the risks associated with money laundering and terrorism financing.

Key Responsibilities:
- Customer Identification & Verification: Reviewing and validating official documents (IDs, proof of address, certificates of incorporation) to confirm identities
- Risk Assessment: Evaluating customers based on geography, business type, and transaction patterns to assign a risk rating
- Due Diligence (CDD & EDD): Performing standard checks (CDD) or Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) for high-risk clients, investigating Source of Wealth (SoW) and Source of Funds (SoF)
- Screening: Checking entities against global sanctions lists, Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) lists, and adverse media
- Ongoing Monitoring: Periodically reviewing client profiles and transactions to detect unusual behavior or changes in risk status
- Reporting: Documenting findings and escalating suspicious activities to the Compliance or Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO)
- Conduct beneficial ownership investigations to identify ultimate beneficial owners
- Perform detailed investigations to identify PEPs, CRAs, Adverse Media, and Sanctions matches
- Conduct periodic reviews of existing client profiles to keep files up-to-date
- Operate within agreed SLAs and confidentiality standards

Requirements:
- A bachelor's degree or relevant work experience in Finance, Law, Business, or Criminal Justice
- Strong understanding of AML/CTF requirements and financial crime risks
- Good relevant AML/KYC experience
- Strong analytical and research skills
- Experience with AML/KYC/Due Diligence processes and systems
- A recognized AML/Compliance qualification (e.g. CAMS, ICA) is highly desirable
- Excellent communication skills, written and verbal
- Strong decision-making capabilities and attention to detail
